allocation_frame.parent_objective: Launch a purchasable product page in the current release window.
allocation_frame.target_threshold: The page is usable and the payment path is validated for launch.
allocation_frame.risk_floor: Do not launch with an unvalidated payment path or a release-blocking page defect.
allocation_frame.evidence_ceiling: Current evidence supports release-window allocation only; it does not prove production revenue or long-term conversion impact.

candidates.title: Continue animation polish
candidates.objective_contribution: Improves presentation after the current page usability threshold has been reached.
candidates.delay_cost_or_opportunity_window: Can be delayed until after launch validation.

candidates.title: Validate the payment path
candidates.objective_contribution: Closes a launch acceptance requirement that currently blocks the target threshold.
candidates.delay_cost_or_opportunity_window: Delay consumes the current release window.
candidates.irreversibility_or_downside: Launching without validation violates the risk floor.

candidates.title: Keep the engineer-day reserved
candidates.objective_contribution: Preserves response capacity if a release-blocking incident appears.
candidates.delay_cost_or_opportunity_window: Reserve expires at the payment validation checkpoint.
candidates.irreversibility_or_downside: Unused reserve can delay payment validation if no incident occurs.

evidence.statement: The product page meets the current usability threshold.
Payment validation has not passed launch acceptance.
evidence.claim_ceiling: Supports payment-path blocker status for this release window only.

evidence.statement: A previous release window was missed after acceptance validation started late.
evidence.claim_ceiling: Supports scoped historical delay risk only; it does not prove the current release will fail.

evidence.statement: Several engineer-days have already been spent on page polish.
evidence.claim_ceiling: Supports historical spend only; the spend is sunk cost and does not justify continuation.

evidence.statement: The release owner requires payment acceptance before launch in the current release window.
evidence.claim_ceiling: Supports the current release authority boundary only.

assumptions.statement: One engineer-day is enough to produce a decision-relevant payment validation result.
assumptions.overturn_condition: The first validation attempt reveals a broader implementation defect.

assumptions.statement: A release incident is possible but not currently observed.
assumptions.overturn_condition: No incident signal appears before the payment checkpoint or a confirmed incident activates the reserve.

assumptions.statement: Switching from page polish to payment validation requires only a short context handoff.
assumptions.overturn_condition: The first handoff reveals a materially larger setup or ownership transfer cost.

assumptions.statement: Completed page and animation work remain reusable after the allocation switch.
assumptions.overturn_condition: The release path or implementation changes in a way that invalidates the completed work.

assumptions.statement: A further meaningful polish tranche consumes one engineer-day.
assumptions.overturn_condition: A bounded estimate or first action shows a materially different remaining cost.

context_items.statement: Decide where the next engineer-day should go.
The user values release quality but does not want polish to delay a blocked launch path.
context_items.decision_relevance: Constrains acceptable trade-offs without proving factual status.

context_items.statement: A previous agent recommended finishing animation polish because it was nearly complete.
The designer says the animation is the most visible sign of quality.
context_items.decision_relevance: Represents advocacy but not accepted evidence.

context_items.statement: The team previously lost a release window because acceptance validation started too late.
context_items.decision_relevance: Relevant scoped history for delay risk; it does not inherit current factual authority.

switching_costs.cost: A short context switch within the same engineer-day.

reusable_assets.asset: Completed page and existing animation work remain reusable after switching.

commitments.statement: The release owner requires payment acceptance before launch.

authority_boundaries.statement: Only the release owner may lower the payment acceptance threshold or authorize launch without it.

known_omissions: No production conversion data is available.
